title: Varia Vertex
description: This mod adds a lot of my hyperfixations (Open to requests, read description for more details)
body:
# About This Mod

This mod is a growing collection of things I personally enjoy and plan to keep expanding over time. It focuses on adding fun, powerful, and sometimes absurd content inspired by media I like, mainly Project Moon works and other interests. The goal of the mod is not balance but creativity, experimentation, and cool references that are fun to mess around with in game.

At the moment, everything added by this mod is obtainable only in Creative Mode. This makes it ideal for testing, showcasing items, building maps, or just having fun without restrictions.

## Current Features

### The Red Mist’s Sword: Mimicry

Inspired by Library of Ruina, this weapon is based on The Red Mist’s iconic sword Mimicry. It is mainly intended for fun and visual appeal rather than survival balance. This item is only obtainable in Creative Mode.

### Singularity

A singularity item that deals 1,000,000 damage. It is intentionally extremely overpowered and exists purely for experimentation, testing, and chaotic fun. This item is only obtainable in Creative Mode.

### Music Disc

A music disc that plays The Red Mist’s theme from Library of Ruina. It is great for atmosphere or just enjoying the soundtrack in game. This item is only obtainable in Creative Mode.

## Planned Additions

This mod will continue to grow as I add more content based on my current and future hyperfixations. Planned inspiration includes Library of Ruina, Limbus Company, ENA Dream BBQ, random memes I find funny, and other media I become interested in. Expect more items, weapons, references, and experimental content to be added over time.

## Notes

This mod is made using MCreator.
If you want to modify this mod publicly or redistribute it elsewhere, please contact me first at the following email address.

[theglassesgalbusiness@gmail.com](mailto:theglassesgalbusiness@gmail.com)
